s.zh: 本该死去，却又一次撑了下来：百折不挠让其倒地幸存（伤口已止血）。10 天后才能再次生效。
s.en: should have died but held on once more: indomitable kept them alive on the ground (wounds have stopped bleeding). It can take effect again in 10 days.

s.zh: 莫名其妙地坏了一大块
胸口的狱火烙印又烫了起来：魔鬼来索债了。
s.en: The hellfire brand on their chest burns again: the devil has come to collect.

s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 新增强力特性 2500 刻出错：
